+import re as _re
+
+
+_ESCAPES = {"n": "\n", "t": "\t", "r": "\r", '"': '"', "\\": "\\"}
+
+
+def parse_env(text: str) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Parse the specified line-based environment format."""
+    result: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for number, original in enumerate(text.split("\n"), 1):
+        line = original.removesuffix("\r")
+        if not line.strip() or line.lstrip().startswith("#"):
+            continue
+
+        raw_key, separator, raw_value = line.partition("=")
+        key = raw_key.strip()
+        # The export separator must contain a literal space, not just a tab.
+        if key.startswith("export "):
+            key = key[len("export "):].strip()
+        if not separator or _re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*", key) is None:
+            # Keep the original content (including any CR) in diagnostics.
+            raise ValueError(f"invalid line {number}: {original}")
+
+        value = raw_value.strip()
+        if len(value) >= 2 and value.startswith('"') and value.endswith('"'):
+            value = _re.sub(
+                r"\\(.)",
+                lambda match: _ESCAPES.get(match[1], match[0]),
+                value[1:-1],
+            )
+        elif len(value) >= 2 and value.startswith("'") and value.endswith("'"):
+            value = value[1:-1]
+        else:
+            comment = _re.search(r"\s+#", value)
+            if comment is not None:
+                value = value[:comment.start()].strip()
+        result[key] = value
+    return result

args.command:
@'
import contextlib
import io
import pathlib
import envparse
from envparse import parse_env

cases = [
    ("A=1\nB = 2 \n", {"A": "1", "B": "2"}),
    ("# c\n\n   \nA=1", {"A": "1"}),
    ('A="x\\ny"', {"A": "x\ny"}),
    ("A='x\\ny'", {"A": "x\\ny"}),
    ("A=hello  # trailing", {"A": "hello"}),
    ("A=a#b", {"A": "a#b"}),
    ("export FOO=bar", {"FOO": "bar"}),
    ("A=1\nA=2", {"A": "2"}),
    ("A=", {"A": ""}),
    ('A="  padded  "', {"A": "  padded  "}),
    ("URL=https://x/y?a=b", {"URL": "https://x/y?a=b"}),
    ("A=1\r\nB=2\r", {"A": "1", "B": "2"}),
    (r'A="\n\t\r\"\\\q"', {"A": '\n\t\r"\\\\q'}),
    (r'A="\\n"', {"A": r'\n'}),
    ('A="x # y"\nB=foo\t#comment', {"A": "x # y", "B": "foo"}),
    ("export   _FOO9 = x=y", {"_FOO9": "x=y"}),
    ("A= #literal", {"A": "#literal"}),
    ("A='\nB=\"", {"A": "'", "B": '"'}),
]
for text, expected in cases:
    assert parse_env(text) == expected, (text, parse_env(text), expected)
for text, message in [
    ("A=1\nnope\n", "invalid line 2: nope"),
    ("1BAD=x", "invalid line 1: 1BAD=x"),
    ("=x", "invalid line 1: =x"),
    ("export\tA=x", "invalid line 1: export\tA=x"),
    ("BAD-KEY=x", "invalid line 1: BAD-KEY=x"),
    ("nope\r\n", "invalid line 1: nope\r"),
]:
    try:
        parse_env(text)
    except ValueError as error:
        assert str(error) == message, (str(error), message)
    else:
        raise AssertionError(text)
assert list(parse_env("B=1\nA=2\nB=3")) == ["B", "A"]
assert [name for name in vars(envparse) if not name.startswith('_')] == ['parse_env']
output = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output), contextlib.redirect_stderr(output):
    exec(compile(pathlib.Path('envparse.py').read_text(), 'envparse.py', 'exec'), {})
assert output.getvalue() == ''
print('All acceptance and edge-case checks passed.')
'@ | python -B -
